# Myeloid and T cell panel comparison 

## Read in data 

```{r}
sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_06.rds")
```

```{r}
PID_T_metacluster <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/data/Tcell_metacluster_PID.csv")
```

## Proportion correlation per PID

### Celltype broad 

```{r}
PID_myeloid_metacluster <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(myeloid_metacluster,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PID_myeloid_metacluster <- PID_myeloid_metacluster %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

PID_metagroups_MY <- PID_myeloid_metacluster  %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "myeloid_metacluster",values_from = "fra") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

colnames(PID_metagroups_MY) <- paste0("MY_",colnames(PID_metagroups_MY))
```

```{r}
PID_metagroups_plot <- PID_myeloid_metacluster  %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "myeloid_metacluster",values_from = "fra")
colnames(PID_metagroups_plot) <- paste0("MY_",colnames(PID_metagroups_plot))

cor_test <- cor.test(PID_metagroups_plot$MY_Ag_M, PID_metagroups_plot$MY_M2_like)

ggplot(PID_metagroups_plot, aes(x = MY_M2_like, y = MY_Ag_M))+  
  geom_point(aes(color = MY_PID),size = 3)+
  geom_smooth(method='lm', formula= y~x, se = TRUE, color = "black")+
  scale_color_manual(values=metadata(sce)$colors$PID)+
  guides(color = "none")+
  ylab("Ag M fraction")+
  xlab("M2 like fraction")+
  theme_classic()+
  ggtitle(paste0("Pearson = ",round(cor_test$estimate, digits = 2), 
                ", p = ", round(cor_test$p.value, digits = 4)))
```



```{r}
PID_metagroups_T <- PID_T_metacluster %>% mutate(fra = as.numeric(fra/100)) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "Tcell_metacluster",values_from = "fra") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

PID_metagroups_T <- na.omit(PID_metagroups_T)
```

```{r}
# CD4 T cells 
PID_CD4_metacluster <- PID_T_metacluster %>% filter(str_detect(Tcell_metacluster, "CD4")) %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

PID_metagroups_CD4 <- PID_CD4_metacluster %>% mutate(fra = as.numeric(fra/100)) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "Tcell_metacluster",values_from = "fra") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

PID_metagroups_CD4 <- na.omit(PID_metagroups_CD4)
```

```{r}
# CD8 T cells 
PID_CD8_metacluster <- PID_T_metacluster %>% filter(str_detect(Tcell_metacluster, "CD8")) %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

PID_metagroups_CD8 <- PID_CD8_metacluster %>% mutate(fra = as.numeric(fra/100)) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "Tcell_metacluster",values_from = "fra") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

PID_metagroups_CD8 <- na.omit(PID_metagroups_CD8)
```


```{r}
# Match by rownames (PID) 
PID_metagroups_MY <- PID_metagroups_MY[match(rownames(PID_metagroups_CD8), rownames(PID_metagroups_MY)),]
PID_metagroups_CD4 <- PID_metagroups_CD4[match(rownames(PID_metagroups_CD8), rownames(PID_metagroups_CD4)),]

# Add together
PID_metagroups_all <- cbind(PID_metagroups_MY, PID_metagroups_CD8, PID_metagroups_CD4)
PID_metagroups_all <- na.omit(PID_metagroups_all)
```


```{r}
# Pearson correlation
PID_cor <- cor(as.matrix(PID_metagroups_all), method = "spearman") 

PID_cor[PID_cor == 1] <- NA 

anno <- data.frame(celltypes = rownames(PID_cor))
anno$type <- ifelse(str_detect(anno$celltypes, "MY"),"MY", ifelse(str_detect(anno$celltypes, "CD4"),"CD4","CD8"))
  
Heatmap(PID_cor, column_split = anno$type, row_split = anno$type, cluster_columns = TRUE, cluster_rows = TRUE)
Heatmap(PID_cor, cluster_columns = TRUE, cluster_rows = TRUE)
```
```{r}
PID_metagroups_plot <- PID_metagroups_all %>% rownames_to_column("PID")

cor_test <- cor.test(PID_metagroups_plot$MY_M2_like, PID_metagroups_plot$`Exhausted-like_CD8`)

ggplot(PID_metagroups_plot, aes(x = MY_M2_like, y = `Exhausted-like_CD8`))+  
  geom_point(aes(color = PID),size = 3)+
  geom_smooth(method='lm', formula= y~x, se = TRUE, color = "black")+
  scale_color_manual(values=metadata(sce)$colors$PID)+
  guides(color = "none")+
  ylab("Exhausted_cytotoxic-like_CD8 fraction")+
  xlab("M2 like fraction")+
  theme_classic()+
  ggtitle(paste0("Pearson = ",round(cor_test$estimate, digits = 2), 
                ", p = ", round(cor_test$p.value, digits = 4)))
```

## Density correlation per PID

```{r}
# Mean tissue area per PID - from myeloid panel here
PID_area <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(tissue_area,PID) %>% unique() %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(mean_tissue_area = mean(tissue_area))
```

### Celltype broad 

```{r}
PID_myeloid_metacluster <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(myeloid_metacluster,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame

PID_myeloid_metacluster$mean_tissue_area <- PID_area$mean_tissue_area[match(PID_myeloid_metacluster$PID, PID_area$PID)]
  
PID_myeloid_metacluster <- PID_myeloid_metacluster %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(density = Freq/(mean_tissue_area/1000000))  

PID_metagroups_MY <- PID_myeloid_metacluster  %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "myeloid_metacluster",values_from = "density") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

colnames(PID_metagroups_MY) <- paste0("MY_",colnames(PID_metagroups_MY))
```

```{r}
# CD4 T cells 
PID_CD4_metacluster <- PID_T_metacluster %>% filter(str_detect(Tcell_metacluster, "CD4")) %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

PID_CD4_metacluster$mean_tissue_area <- PID_area$mean_tissue_area[match(PID_CD4_metacluster$PID, PID_area$PID)]
  
PID_CD4_metacluster <- PID_CD4_metacluster %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(density = Freq/(mean_tissue_area/1000000)) 

PID_metagroups_CD4 <- PID_CD4_metacluster %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "Tcell_metacluster",values_from = "density") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

PID_metagroups_CD4 <- na.omit(PID_metagroups_CD4)
```

```{r}
# CD8 T cells 
PID_CD8_metacluster <- PID_T_metacluster %>% filter(str_detect(Tcell_metacluster, "CD8")) %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

PID_CD8_metacluster$mean_tissue_area <- PID_area$mean_tissue_area[match(PID_CD8_metacluster$PID, PID_area$PID)]
  
PID_CD8_metacluster <- PID_CD8_metacluster %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(density = Freq/(mean_tissue_area/1000000)) 

PID_metagroups_CD8 <- PID_CD8_metacluster %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "Tcell_metacluster",values_from = "density") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

PID_metagroups_CD8 <- na.omit(PID_metagroups_CD8)
```

```{r}
# Match by rownames (PID) 
PID_metagroups_MY <- PID_metagroups_MY[match(rownames(PID_metagroups_CD8), rownames(PID_metagroups_MY)),]
PID_metagroups_CD4 <- PID_metagroups_CD4[match(rownames(PID_metagroups_CD8), rownames(PID_metagroups_CD4)),]

# Add together
PID_metagroups_all <- cbind(PID_metagroups_MY, PID_metagroups_CD8, PID_metagroups_CD4)
PID_metagroups_all <- na.omit(PID_metagroups_all)

PID_metagroups_all_scaled <- scale(PID_metagroups_all)
```

```{r}
# Color for heatmaps 
colours <- c("#4575B4", "white", "#D73027")
breaks <- c(-0.8, 0.8, 0.05)
breaks <- seq(from = breaks[1], to = breaks[2], by = breaks[3])
pal <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(colours)(length(breaks))
col <- colorRamp2(breaks, pal)
```

```{r}
# Pearson correlation
PID_cor <- cor(as.matrix(PID_metagroups_all_scaled), method = "pearson") 

PID_cor[PID_cor == 1] <- NA 

anno <- data.frame(celltypes = rownames(PID_cor))
anno$type <- ifelse(str_detect(anno$celltypes, "MY"),"MY", ifelse(str_detect(anno$celltypes, "CD4"),"CD4","CD8"))
  
Heatmap(PID_cor, col = col, column_split = anno$type, row_split = anno$type, cluster_columns = TRUE, cluster_rows = TRUE)
Heatmap(PID_cor, col = col, cluster_columns = TRUE, cluster_rows = TRUE)
```


## Differential abundance testing

### Myeloid based patient groups 

#### Celltype broad 

```{r}
# Crate binary patient groups
## Patient groups 
unique(sce$PID_metagroups_names)
unique(sce$PID_metagroups_scaled_names) #These are potentially more informative! 
sce$PID_metagroups_names <- sce$PID_metagroups_scaled_names

sce$M2_dom <- ifelse(sce$PID_metagroups_names == "M2_dom", "1", "0")
sce$M1_dom <- ifelse(sce$PID_metagroups_names == "M1_dom", "1", "0")
sce$AgM_dom <- ifelse(sce$PID_metagroups_names == "AgM_dom", "1", "0")
sce$MDSC_dom <- ifelse(sce$PID_metagroups_names == "MDSC_dom", "1", "0")
#sce$Mix <- ifelse(sce$PID_metagroups_names == "Mix", "1", "0")
```

```{r}
PID_T_metacluster <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/data/Tcell_metacluster_PID.csv")
```

##### Combined CD4/CD8 

```{r}
### Differential abundance analysis based on edgeR
library(edgeR)

DA <- lapply(c("M2_dom", "M1_dom", "AgM_dom", "MDSC_dom"), function(x){

abundances <- PID_T_metacluster %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "Tcell_metacluster",values_from = "Freq") %>% column_to_rownames("PID") %>% t()

abundances <- unclass(abundances) 

#relevant patient metadata (Re-level for baseline)
meta <- colData(sce)[match(colnames(abundances), sce$PID),]

meta[,x] <- relevel(x=factor(meta[,x]), ref = "0")

#filter
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta[,x]),]
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% meta$PID]

#create DGEList - based on edgeR package
y.ab <- DGEList(abundances, samples=meta, group = meta[,x])

#Design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~group, data = y.ab$samples)

#Visualize
# logCPM of abundances per cluster
cur_mat <- edgeR::cpm(abundances,prior.count = 1,log = TRUE)

# Estimate NB and QL dispersion 
y.ab <- estimateDisp(y.ab, design, trend="none")

fit.ab <- glmQLFit(y.ab, design, robust=TRUE, abundance.trend=FALSE)

# Test for differential abundance of clusters between tumor stages
res <- glmQLFTest(fit.ab, coef=ncol(design))

DA <- res$table

DA <- topTags(res, n = nrow(DA), adjust.method = "BH")$table

DA <- DA %>% mutate(cluster = rownames(DA), sign = DA$FDR<0.05, result = ifelse(DA$logFC > 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "UP",ifelse(DA$logFC < 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(logFC))

DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)
DA$category <- x

return(DA)
})

DA_out <- do.call(rbind, DA)
```


```{r}
# FDR at 0.1 with trends
DA_out$result <- ifelse(DA_out$logFC > 0 & DA_out$FDR < 0.1, "UP",
                             ifelse(DA_out$logFC > 0 & DA_out$PValue < 0.05, "UP_trend", 
                                    ifelse(DA_out$logFC < 0 & DA_out$FDR < 0.1, "DOWN", 
                                           ifelse(DA_out$logFC < 0 & DA_out$PValue < 0.05, "DOWN_trend","NOTSIG"))))

## hierarchical clustering on logFC
cur_df <- DA_out %>% select(cluster, category, logFC) %>% pivot_wider(values_from = logFC, names_from = cluster)

# rows 
dd <- dist(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)], method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
row_sorted <- hc$order
DA_out$category <- factor(DA_out$category, levels = cur_df[row_sorted,]$category)

# columns 
dd <- dist(t(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)]), method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
column_sorted <- hc$order

DA_out$cluster <- factor(DA_out$cluster, levels = colnames(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)][,column_sorted]))

ggplot(DA_out, aes(x=cluster, y = category,col = logFC, size= -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8")+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = DA_out,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(FDR), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#9f1214","UP_trend" = "#e73032", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN_trend" = "#428bc7","DOWN" = "#25567d"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```
